name: Rhubarb Lip Sync
notes: 2026-11-01: CLI that turns a voice recording into timed mouth shapes (JSON/TSV); proposed driver for avatar or 2D mouth animation.
2026-11-15: GitHub release page omits the year in its April 3 timestamp; year 2025 is corroborated by a release index. Latest release tag remains v1.14.0.
source: conversation 2026-11-01: character and figure tooling gap
summary: Desktop CLI analyzes WAV or Ogg audio and produces timestamped mouth-shape cues in TSV, XML or JSON, with integrations for several animation applications. English recognition uses PocketSphinx; a phonetic recognizer is available for other languages with lower precision. Strength: turns existing dialogue recordings into lightweight cues that can drive 2D mouth animation.
use_when: Create timestamped mouth-shape cues from recorded dialogue for a 2D character
Use over manual cueing when timing can be generated from WAV or Ogg audio
avoid_when: Use a general audio alignment tool for word-level transcript timing rather than viseme cues
Use a runtime face tracker for live webcam or real-time speech animation
license: MIT (project); bundled third-party dependencies have their own permissive licences, including BSD and Boost

install.macos: Download and unpack the macOS archive from the official GitHub release

assessment.rationale: The official release page marks v1.14.0 as latest and lists an April 3 release; date year is not shown there, though 2025 is corroborated by a release index. MIT project with separately listed third-party licences. Native CLI emits timestamped mouth-shape data from WAV/Ogg.
